quote: If a company set out to figure out how to kill the GTA franchise, it would be hard to imagine a worse way of doing it. After removing the core team and writing staff who made GTA what it is, the people brought in to replace them have delivered nothing more than a pile of garbage wrapped in a pretty package.Lacking the kind of characters players can identify with from the very first minutes, and a compelling narrative that unfolds like a film script, this game is soulless, preachy, demeaning toward men, and riddled with forced “diversity,” along with countless other flaws that would take far too long to list. This cannot be a GTA game, and it never should have been.Every player who is unhappy with the state of this game should demand a refund. The gaming industry has become a plaything in the hands of a handful of deranged minority activists. Sadly, GTA is the latest example of this.
